name: Satori Chuunibyou Soudanshitsu -Dai Ni Genjitsu no Hon'yakusha-
original_name: さとり中二病相談室 -第二現実の翻訳者-
source:
You are the director of The Second Reality Room.

Meet Visitors experiencing chuunibyou and listen to the troubles that make sense in their world.

Uncover what they can’t say outright—the feelings at the heart of the “Second Reality” they believe is real.

And trace the path that led them there.

It starts small.
But the circle slowly widens, drawing in those around you... until it becomes something much bigger.

If you've ever felt misunderstood, this story is for you.

[From Steam]
